once and future king.why: The King Arthur legend retold with humour and sadness, with a whimsical first part and darker later parts.

antkind.title: Antkind
antkind.author: Charlie Kaufman
antkind.why: A giant, absurd comic novel by the filmmaker about a failing critic and a vast memory-based conspiracy.

demons.title: Demons
demons.author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
demons.why: A tale of revolutionaries and moral collapse in provincial Russia; some readers name it Dostoevsky's best.

pearl.title: The Pearl
pearl.author: John Steinbeck
pearl.why: A poor pearl diver finds a great pearl and loses everything; brief and unforgettable, widely read at school.

my dark vanessa.title: My dark Vanessa
my dark vanessa.author: Kate Elizabeth Russell
my dark vanessa.why: A woman reckons with an abusive relationship with a teacher; hard to read but sticks with readers.

only good indians.title: The Only Good Indians
only good indians.author: Stephen Graham Jones
only good indians.why: Four Native American men are hunted by a vengeful spirit after an old hunting crime; vivid horror.

bleak house.title: Bleak House
bleak house.author: Charles Dickens
bleak house.why: Dickens's long satire of the legal system, whose huge cast and plots reward patient readers.

breakfast of champions.title: Breakfast of Champions
breakfast of champions.author: Kurt Vonnegut
breakfast of champions.why: A strange, comic Vonnegut novel about a car dealer and a sci-fi writer; one of his stranger books.

fountainhead.title: The Fountainhead
fountainhead.author: Ayn Rand
fountainhead.why: An uncompromising architect hero and a philosophy of selfishness; loved by some young readers, loathed by others.

me talk pretty one day.title: Me Talk Pretty One Day
me talk pretty one day.author: David Sedaris
me talk pretty one day.why: Essays about learning French and growing up, praised as laugh-out-loud funny.

magician.title: The Magician
magician.author: William Somerset Maugham
magician.why: Not a clear recommendation of this book.

ready player one.title: Ready Player One
ready player one.author: Ernest Cline
ready player one.why: A virtual-reality treasure hunt packed with 1980s pop culture; fun, easy and a nostalgic page-turner.

blue castle.title: The blue castle
blue castle.author: Lucy Maud Montgomery
blue castle.why: A shy woman defies her family in a century-old romance that readers call lighthearted and still moving.

its.title: It
its.author: Stephen King
its.why: Not a clear recommendation of this book.

no country for old men.title: No Country for Old Men
no country for old men.author: Cormac McCarthy
no country for old men.why: A hunter finds drug money and is chased by a killer in a sparse, violent modern western.

third policeman.title: The Third Policeman
third policeman.author: Flann O'Brien
third policeman.why: A surreal comic tale of a man, a murder and a strange police station; weird and rewarding for patient readers.

wanderers.title: Wanderers
wanderers.author: Chuck Wendig
wanderers.why: A mysterious sleepwalking plague and a trek across America; readers praise its plot, if not the prose.

my antonia.title: My Ántonia
my antonia.author: Willa Cather
my antonia.why: A Nebraska immigrant girl's growing up on the prairie, with beautiful, quiet prose that readers return to.

in memoriam.title: In Memoriam
in memoriam.author: Alice Winn
in memoriam.why: Two boys in a boarding school in the First World War fall in love; harrowing, beautiful and tense.

anthropocene reviewed.title: The Anthropocene Reviewed
anthropocene reviewed.author: John Green
anthropocene reviewed.why: Short essays rating different parts of the human world on a five-star scale; the chapter on sunsets is a favourite.

green mile.title: The Green Mile
green mile.author: Stephen King
green mile.why: A prison guard on death row and a miraculous inmate; King's story that made readers cry.

vurt.title: Vurt
vurt.author: Jeff Noon
vurt.why: A wild cyberpunk story of a man seeking his sister in a drug-like virtual world, strange and heart-wrenching.

moon is a harsh mistress.title: The moon is a harsh mistress
moon is a harsh mistress.author: Robert A. Heinlein
moon is a harsh mistress.why: A rebel moon colony fights Earth with the help of a self-aware computer; an enduring Heinlein classic.

im thinking of ending things.title: I'm Thinking of Ending Things
im thinking of ending things.author: Iain Reid
im thinking of ending things.why: A couple's drive to meet his parents spirals into dread; a quick, twisty read with a strange finale.

imajica.title: Imajica
imajica.author: Clive Barker
imajica.why: A vast dark fantasy of hidden worlds, desire and magic; long and strange, and gripping from the first pages.

waves.title: The Waves
waves.author: Virginia Woolf
waves.why: Six friends' inner lives in poetic, stream-of-consciousness prose; beautiful but demanding, loved by readers of experimental fiction.

exhalation.title: Exhalation
exhalation.author: Ted Chiang
exhalation.why: Ted Chiang's thoughtful short science fiction about time, free will and consciousness, picked as a favourite story collection.

shuggie bain.title: Shuggie Bain
shuggie bain.author: Douglas Stuart
shuggie bain.why: A boy in 1980s Glasgow cares for his alcoholic mother; devastating and beautifully written.

kaiju preservation society.title: The Kaiju Preservation Society
kaiju preservation society.author: John Scalzi
kaiju preservation society.why: A breezy adventure about people protecting giant monsters on a parallel Earth; just fun, with quick, witty writing.

jude the obscure.title: Jude the Obscure
jude the obscure.author: Thomas Hardy
jude the obscure.why: A stonemason's doomed struggle against class and marriage in Victorian England, grim and moving.

of human bondage.title: Of Human Bondage
of human bondage.author: William Somerset Maugham
of human bondage.why: A long coming-of-age story of an orphan with a club foot, called one of the best books by readers.

careless people.title: Careless People
careless people.author: Sarah Wynn-Williams
careless people.why: An insider's account of working at Facebook, interesting and eye-opening for many readers.

gnomon.title: Gnomon
gnomon.author: Nick Harkaway
gnomon.why: A near-future surveillance state and an interrogation across layered stories; complex but rewarding for fans of puzzle plots.

death of the author.title: Death of the Author
death of the author.author: Nnedi Okorafor
death of the author.why: A novel where a writer's life and her creations intertwine; a recent release that readers enjoyed.

alias grace.title: alias Grace
alias grace.author: Margaret Atwood
alias grace.why: A fictional take on a real convicted murderess, told through her memory; Atwood's literary mystery.

riddley walker.title: Riddley Walker
riddley walker.author: Russell Hoban
riddley walker.why: A boy narrates a post-nuclear England in invented broken English; underrated, odd and moving.

solenoid.title: Solenoid
solenoid.author: Mircea Cărtărescu
solenoid.why: A Romanian teacher's mundane life collides with surreal visions in a huge, brilliant dreamlike novel.

invisible monsters.title: Invisible Monsters
invisible monsters.author: Chuck Palahniuk
invisible monsters.why: A disfigured model's twisted road trip in this wild, transgressive novel.

bury our bones in the midnight soil.title: Bury Our Bones in the Midnight Soil
bury our bones in the midnight soil.author: V. E. Schwab
bury our bones in the midnight soil.why: Not a clear recommendation of this book.

lady tans circle of women.title: Lady Tan's Circle of Women
lady tans circle of women.author: Lisa See
lady tans circle of women.why: A woman physician in Ming-dynasty China fights for her place; engrossing historical fiction on women's lives.

mary.title: Mary
mary.author: Nat Cassidy
mary.why: Not a clear recommendation of this book.

stiff.title: Stiff
stiff.author: Mary Roach
stiff.why: A funny, fascinating tour of what happens to human bodies after death, praised as laugh-out-loud science writing.

vita nostra.title: Vita Nostra
vita nostra.author: Marina and Sergey Dyachenko
vita nostra.why: A girl enters a strange institute where reality bends and she is slowly transformed; readers re-read it yearly.

down the drain.title: Down the Drain
down the drain.author: Julia Fox
down the drain.why: A celebrity memoir read cover to cover in one day by fans who found it gripping.

under the whispering door.title: Under the Whispering Door
under the whispering door.author: T. J. Klune
under the whispering door.why: A cozy afterlife tale about a man who runs a tea shop for the dead; warm and good for grief.

outlander.title: Outlander
outlander.author: Diana Gabaldon
outlander.why: A WWII nurse is thrown back to 18th-century Scotland; a huge romantic saga with devoted fans.

forever.title: Forever
forever.author: Pete Hamill
forever.why: An Irish man gains immortality as long as he stays in New York, tracing the city's history.

gormenghast.title: Gormenghast
gormenghast.author: Mervyn Peake
gormenghast.why: A vast crumbling castle and its rigid inhabitants, written in rich, long sentences; a gothic classic of fantasy.

ringworld.title: Ringworld
ringworld.author: Larry Niven
ringworld.why: Explorers visit an enormous artificial ring with a strange civilisation; a hard-SF classic of big ideas.

last letter.title: The Last Letter
last letter.author: Rebecca Yarros
last letter.why: A wartime love story told in letters; an ugly-cry read for those who like emotional romance.

neverending story.title: The Neverending Story
neverending story.author: Michael Ende

housekeeping.title: Housekeeping

armor.title: Armor

burial rites.title: Burial Rites

prophet.title: The Prophet

trees.title: The Trees

little friend.title: The Little Friend

pushing ice.title: Pushing Ice

luminaries.title: The Luminaries

passenger.title: The Passenger

separate peace.title: A Separate Peace

horse.title: Horse

gateway.title: Gateway

borne.title: Borne

unconsoled.title: The Unconsoled

shades of grey.title: Shades of Grey

deluge.title: The Deluge

wind and truth.title: Wind and Truth

redwall.title: Redwall

age of innocence.title: The Age of Innocence

land.title: Land

anne of green gables.title: Anne of Green Gables

americanah.title: Americanah

last samurai.title: The Last Samurai

augustus.title: Augustus

six of crows.title: Six of Crows

madame bovary.title: Madame Bovary

snow child.title: The Snow Child

world war z.title: World War Z

heroes.title: The Heroes

talisman.title: The talisman

redshirts.title: Redshirts

carrie.title: Carrie

light.title: Light

quicksilver.title: Quicksilver

i am legend.title: I Am Legend

alienist.title: The Alienist

gift of fear.title: The Gift of Fear

quantum thief.title: The Quantum Thief

rant.title: Rant

being mortal.title: Being Mortal

dragons egg.title: Dragon's egg

half of a yellow sun.title: Half of a Yellow Sun

milkman.title: Milkman

light in august.title: Light in August

empire of pain.title: Empire of Pain

sellout.title: The Sellout

nation.title: Nation

where the crawdads sing.title: Where the Crawdads Sing

butchers crossing.title: Butcher's Crossing

blood music.title: Blood Music

rivers of london.title: Rivers of London

beach music.title: Beach Music

da vinci code.title: The Da Vinci Code

westing game.title: The Westing Game

sympathizer.title: The Sympathizer

lord of the flies.title: Lord of the Flies

alchemised.title: Alchemised

jerusalem.title: Jerusalem

i claudius.title: I, Claudius

brother.title: Brother

three men in a boat.title: Three Men in a Boat (to say nothing of the dog)

art thief.title: The Art Thief

hiroshima.title: Hiroshima

mists of avalon.title: The Mists of Avalon

service model.title: Service Model

sea.title: The sea

solito.title: Solito

hello beautiful.title: Hello Beautiful

three musketeers.title: The Three Musketeers

vanishing half.title: The Vanishing Half

altered carbon.title: Altered Carbon

carmilla.title: Carmilla

galapagos.title: Galápagos
galapagos.author: Kurt Vonnegut

love in the time of cholera.title: Love in the Time of Cholera

love in the time of cholera.why: Commenters mostly say they were disappointed or gave up on it.

barkskins.title: Barkskins
barkskins.author: Annie Proulx

one day everyone will have always been a.title: One Day, Everyone Will Have Always Been Against This

lion the witch and the wardrobe.title: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe

wicked.title: Wicked

guns of august.title: The Guns of August

going postal.title: Going Postal

ceremony.title: Ceremony

silence.title: Silence

lucifers hammer.title: Lucifer's Hammer

cosmos.title: Cosmos

executioners song.title: The executioner's song

theo of golden.title: Theo of Golden

automatic noodle.title: Automatic Noodle

bean trees.title: The Bean Trees

thirteenth tale.title: The Thirteenth Tale

still life.title: Still Life

between the world and me.title: Between the World and Me

familiar.title: The Familiar
familiar.author: Leigh Bardugo
familiar.why: Comments split, and one reader says it was thin; it is not clearly recommended.

havoc.title: Havoc
havoc.author: Christopher Bollen
havoc.why: Readers mostly describe it as bewildering and unpleasant rather than recommending it.

starving saints.title: The Starving Saints

book.title: The Book
book.author: Alan Watts
book.why: Comments are about other books and series; this title and author do not match what readers discuss.

game of thrones.title: A Game of Thrones
game of thrones.author: George R. R. Martin

i robot.title: I, Robot

whistler.title: Whistler
whistler.author: Ann Patchett

strange sally diamond.title: Strange Sally Diamond

demian.title: Demian
demian.author: Hermann Hesse

to be taught if fortunate.title: To Be Taught, If Fortunate

anthem.title: Anthem
anthem.author: Ayn Rand

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.author: Dean Koontz

under the dome.title: Under the Dome

devolution.title: Devolution

some desperate glory.title: Some Desperate Glory

ficciones.title: Ficciones
ficciones.author: Jorge Luis Borges

swanns way.title: Swann's Way

time and again.title: Time and Again

signature of all things.title: The signature of all things

fall of hyperion.title: The Fall of Hyperion
fall of hyperion.author: Dan Simmons
fall of hyperion.why: The conclusion of Simmons's Hyperion story, about AI and the fate of humanity; recommended alongside the first book.

thousand autumns of jacob de zoet.title: The Thousand Autumns of Jacob de Zoet

thousand autumns of jacob de zoet.why: A Dutch clerk at Dejima in 1799 Japan; an epic readers value for its richness.

franny and zooey.title: Franny and Zooey
franny and zooey.author: J. D. Salinger

clan of the cave bear.title: The Clan of the Cave Bear
clan of the cave bear.author: Jean M. Auel

fight club.title: Fight Club
fight club.author: Chuck Palahniuk
fight club.why: Comments split, with readers calling it a mistake to start with; not clearly recommended.

throne of glass.title: Throne of Glass
throne of glass.author: Sarah J. Maas
throne of glass.why: Reader says they did not hate it but did not like it much; not clearly recommended.

if you tell.title: If You Tell

passing.title: Passing

godfather.title: The Godfather
godfather.author: Mario Puzo
godfather.why: The title only appears in a list, with no real recommendation in the comments.

brothers k.title: The brothers K

culture.title: Culture

unwind.title: Unwind

all the kings men.title: All the King's Men

all the kings men.why: A journalist works for a populist Southern governor; a Pulitzer-winning novel about power and corruption.

hogfather.title: Hogfather

hogfather.why: Death takes over the Hogfather's job in a Discworld story about belief and what makes us human.

leviathan wakes.title: Leviathan Wakes

persepolis.title: Persepolis
persepolis.author: Marjane Satrapi

maus.title: Maus

ruins.title: The Ruins

art of racing in the rain.title: The Art of Racing in the Rain

buddenbrooks.title: Buddenbrooks
buddenbrooks.author: Thomas Mann

fevre dream.title: Fevre Dream

touching the void.title: Touching the void
touching the void.author: Joe Simpson

everyone in this room will someday be de.title: Everyone in This Room Will Someday Be Dead

till we have faces.title: Till We Have Faces

moonstone.title: The Moonstone
moonstone.author: Wilkie Collins

holly.title: Holly
holly.author: Stephen King
holly.why: One reader says they lost interest halfway through; not clearly recommended.

joy luck club.title: The Joy Luck Club

joy luck club.why: Four Chinese-American mothers and daughters share their stories; readers recommend it for multi-generational family drama.

elder race.title: Elder Race

light brigade.title: The Light Brigade

satanic verses.title: The Satanic Verses

rise and fall of the third reich.title: The Rise and Fall of the Third Reich

player piano.title: Player Piano
player piano.author: Kurt Vonnegut

2 deaths of evelyn hardcastle.title: The 7 1/2 Deaths of Evelyn Hardcastle

eyes and the impossible.title: The Eyes and the Impossible

heart the lover.title: Heart the Lover

walden.title: Walden
walden.author: Henry David Thoreau

horrorstor.title: Horrorstör

olive kitteridge.title: Olive Kitteridge
olive kitteridge.author: Elizabeth Strout

years of rice and salt.title: The years of rice and salt
years of rice and salt.author: Kim Stanley Robinson

buckeye.title: Buckeye
buckeye.author: Patrick Ryan
buckeye.why: Mentioned only as being started, with no real recommendation.

wellness.title: Wellness
wellness.author: Nathan Hill
wellness.why: A satirical novel about a marriage and modern obsessions with health; one reader rated it ten out of ten.

kraken.title: Kraken
kraken.author: China Miéville
kraken.why: Readers split between loving the author and losing interest in this book.

treasure island.title: Treasure Island
treasure island.author: Robert Louis Stevenson
treasure island.why: A boy joins a pirate treasure hunt; a not-heavy adventure classic recommended as a great story.

history of love.title: The History of Love
history of love.author: Nicole Krauss
history of love.why: An old man and a girl are tied together by a lost manuscript; readers go back to it repeatedly.

tommyknockers.title: The Tommyknockers
tommyknockers.author: Stephen King
tommyknockers.why: A small town is changed by a buried spacecraft; fun sci-fi horror from King.

libra.title: Libra
libra.author: Don DeLillo
libra.why: DeLillo's fictional take on Lee Harvey Oswald and the Kennedy assassination; readers who liked White Noise seek it out.

colour of magic.title: The Colour of Magic

gardens of the moon.title: Gardens of the Moon

dies the fire.title: Dies the fire

matilda.title: Matilda

institute.title: The Institute

nightbitch.title: Nightbitch

gates of fire.title: Gates of fire

perfect marriage.title: The Perfect Marriage

looking for alaska.title: Looking for Alaska

warbreaker.title: Warbreaker

warbreaker.why: Readers split and one calls it bad on many levels; not clearly recommended.

whalefall.title: Whalefall

my cousin rachel.title: My Cousin Rachel

outer dark.title: Outer Dark

broken country.title: Broken Country

dark places.title: Dark Places

rook.title: The Rook

heroes die.title: Heroes die

zombie.title: Zombie
zombie.author: Joyce Carol Oates

eragon.title: Eragon

power of now.title: The Power of Now

shadow of the gods.title: The Shadow of the Gods

letters to a young poet.title: Letters to a young poet

erasure.title: Erasure
erasure.author: Percival L. Everett

testaments.title: The Testaments

bibliophobia.title: Bibliophobia

bibliophobia.why: A book of personal essays about how reading changes our lives, recommended for writers of memoir.

salt.title: Salt

nothing to envy.title: Nothing to envy

peace like a river.title: Peace like a river

tin drum.title: The Tin Drum

beautiful ugly.title: Beautiful Ugly
beautiful ugly.author: Alice Feeney
beautiful ugly.why: One reader calls it terrible but readable; not a clear recommendation.

elegance of the hedgehog.title: The Elegance of the Hedgehog

centennial.title: Centennial

space between worlds.title: The Space Between Worlds

atomic habits.title: Atomic Habits

brooklyn.title: Brooklyn

dirty job.title: A Dirty Job

confessions of a prairie bitch.title: Confessions of a prairie bitch

snow.title: Snow

furiously happy.title: Furiously Happy

guns germs and steel.title: Guns, Germs, and Steel

saving noah.title: Saving Noah

kristin lavransdatter.title: Kristin Lavransdatter

egg.title: The Egg

divine comedy.title: The Divine Comedy

engine summer.title: Engine Summer

malazan book of the fallen.title: Malazan Book of the Fallen

ethan frome.title: Ethan Frome

andromeda strain.title: The Andromeda Strain

to sleep in a sea of stars.title: To Sleep in a Sea of Stars

dragonriders of pern.title: The Dragonriders of Pern

sentence.title: The Sentence

city we became.title: The City We Became

cage of souls.title: Cage of Souls

windup girl.title: The Windup Girl

king in yellow.title: The King in Yellow

measure.title: The Measure

door.title: The Door

coraline.title: Coraline

martin eden.title: Martin Eden

eye of the bedlam bride.title: The Eye of the Bedlam Bride

exordia.title: Exordia

woman in me.title: The Woman in Me

currently reading.title: Currently Reading

fellowship of the ring.title: The Fellowship of the Ring

sound of gravel.title: The sound of gravel

sophies world.title: Sophie's World

elantris.title: Elantris

flashlight.title: Flashlight

tau zero.title: Tau Zero

lords of discipline.title: The Lords of Discipline

maid.title: The Maid
maid.author: Nita Prose
maid.why: Mixed to negative reception in the comments.

arrival.title: Stories of Your Life and Others

plot.title: The Plot

iron widow.title: Iron Widow

greenlights.title: Greenlights

never flinch.title: Never Flinch

hollow places.title: The Hollow Places

young mungo.title: Young Mungo

mysterious benedict society.title: The Mysterious Benedict Society

kings of the wyld.title: Kings of the wyld

bag of bones.title: Bag of Bones

road to tender hearts.title: The Road to Tender Hearts

last question.title: The Last Question

jade city.title: Jade City

harsh mistress.title: The moon is a harsh mistress

quiet.title: Quiet

columbine.title: Columbine

children.title: The Children

lost city of z.title: The Lost City of Z

portrait of a lady.title: The Portrait of a Lady

ship of fools.title: Ship of fools

rabbit run.title: Rabbit, Run

good person.title: A Good Person

manhunt.title: Manhunt

witches.title: The Witches

juice.title: Juice

little princess.title: A Little Princess

less than zero.title: Less than Zero

victorian psycho.title: Victorian Psycho

lucky jim.title: Lucky Jim

five little indians.title: Five Little Indians

me before you.title: Me Before You

tell the wolves im home.title: Tell the Wolves I'm Home

lion women of tehran.title: The Lion Women of Tehran

fledgling.title: Fledgling

wind in the willows.title: The Wind in the Willows

titus groan.title: Titus Groan

choice.title: The Choice

marabou stork nightmares.title: Marabou Stork Nightmares

girls.title: The Girls

girls.why: Comments are mostly unrelated or negative.

post office.title: Post office
post office.author: Charles Bukowski

paladin of souls.title: Paladin of Souls

empire of silence.title: Empire of silence

unworthy.title: The Unworthy

english patient.title: The English Patient

cathedral.title: Cathedral

molokai.title: Moloka'i

plainsong.title: Plainsong

between two kingdoms.title: Between Two Kingdoms

northanger abbey.title: Northanger Abbey

dawn of everything.title: The Dawn of Everything

needful things.title: Needful Things

exodus.title: Exodus

antidote.title: The Antidote

wrong place wrong time.title: Wrong Place Wrong Time

fablehaven.title: Fablehaven

ninefox gambit.title: Ninefox Gambit

ballad of songbirds and snakes.title: The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes

mountains sing.title: The Mountains Sing

alive.title: Alive: The Story of the Andes Survivors

foreigner.title: Foreigner

go tell it on the mountain.title: Go Tell It on the Mountain

bloom.title: Bloom

pisces.title: The pisces

always coming home.title: Always Coming Home

hangsaman.title: Hangsaman

compound.title: The Compound

steel beach.title: Steel beach

shockwave rider.title: The Shockwave Rider

witch king.title: Witch King

jonathan strange mr norrell.title: Jonathan Strange and Mr. Norrell

doppelganger.title: Doppelganger: A Trip into the Mirror World

source.title: The Source

prince.title: The Prince

ask the dust.title: Ask the dust

ella minnow pea.title: Ella Minnow Pea

i am pilgrim.title: I am Pilgrim

daisy darker.title: Daisy Darker

cats eye.title: Cat's Eye

skippy dies.title: Skippy Dies

woman in the dunes.title: The Woman in the Dunes

sourdough.title: Sourdough

best offer wins.title: Best Offer Wins

everyone in my family has killed someone.title: Everyone in My Family Has Killed Someone

speak.title: Speak

sailor who fell from grace with the sea.title: The Sailor Who Fell from Grace with the Sea

miracle in the andes.title: Miracle in the Andes

annie bot.title: Annie Bot

interpreter of maladies.title: Interpreter of Maladies

quincunx.title: The Quincunx
quincunx.author: Charles Palliser

red dragon.title: Red Dragon

gate of the feral gods.title: The Gate of the Feral Gods

stardust.title: Stardust

stardust.why: Comments are lukewarm; praise is mainly for the film.

jazz.title: Jazz

jazz.why: Comments are lukewarm and mention struggling with it.

wizard of the crow.title: Wizard of the Crow

startide rising.title: Startide Rising

mad mabel.title: Mad Mabel

decameron.title: The Decameron

neapolitan novels.title: The Neapolitan Novels

london falling.title: London Falling

julia.title: Julia

haar.title: The Haar

absolution.title: Absolution

vorrh.title: The Vorrh

nothing.title: Nothing

sea of rust.title: Sea of Rust

people of the book.title: People of the Book

ill be gone in the dark.title: I'll Be Gone in the Dark

leviathan.title: Leviathan

collected schizophrenias.title: The Collected Schizophrenias

tortilla flat.title: Tortilla Flat

binti.title: Binti

half his age.title: Half His Age
half his age.author: Jennette McCurdy
half his age.why: Comments only mention reading it without recommendation.

prestige.title: The Prestige
prestige.author: Christopher Priest
prestige.why: Two rival Victorian magicians feud and sabotage each other; twisty, better than the film according to readers.

last chance to see.title: Last Chance to See
last chance to see.author: Douglas Adams and Mark Carwardine

riyria revelations.title: Riyria Revelations

invention of morel.title: The Invention of Morel

frankenstein by mary shelley.title: Frankenstein
frankenstein by mary shelley.author: Mary Shelley

swamplandia.title: Swamplandia!
swamplandia.author: Karen Russell

cold comfort farm.title: Cold Comfort Farm
cold comfort farm.author: Stella Gibbons

deliverance.title: Deliverance
deliverance.author: James Dickey
deliverance.why: Four men on a canoe trip in Georgia face violence; short, intense and different from the film.

winds of war.title: The Winds of War
winds of war.author: Herman Wouk

number of the beast.title: The Number of the Beast
number of the beast.author: Robert A. Heinlein

alice network.title: The Alice Network
alice network.author: Kate Quinn
alice network.why: Women spies in World War I and a search in 1947; a popular historical page-turner.

shock doctrine.title: The Shock Doctrine

demon.title: The demon
demon.author: Hubert Selby, Jr.

emergence.title: Emergence
emergence.author: David R. Palmer
emergence.why: A young girl emerges from a fallout shelter after nuclear war; a childhood favourite.

foundryside.title: Foundryside
foundryside.author: Robert Jackson Bennett
foundryside.why: A thief in a city where objects can be programmed with magic; inventive and fast-paced.

destiny of the republic.title: The destiny of the republic
destiny of the republic.author: Candice Millard
destiny of the republic.why: The assassination of President Garfield told as a compelling narrative; a one-sitting read.

slapstick.title: Slapstick
slapstick.author: Kurt Vonnegut
slapstick.why: Vonnegut's weird tale of a giant-sized future; hilarious and sad together.

girl with all the gifts.title: The Girl with All the Gifts
girl with all the gifts.author: M. R. Carey

east.title: East
east.author: Edith Pattou
east.why: A girl travels with a white bear in a retelling of East of the Sun, West of the Moon; many reread yearly.

amber spyglass.title: The Amber Spyglass
amber spyglass.author: Philip Pullman
amber spyglass.why: Final book of His Dark Materials, resolving the multiverse story; a genuinely satisfying conclusion.

sea the sea.title: The Sea, the Sea
sea the sea.author: Iris Murdoch
sea the sea.why: A retired theatre director retires to the sea and becomes obsessed with a past love; readers rate it highly.

hollywood park.title: Hollywood Park
hollywood park.author: Mikel Jollett
hollywood park.why: A musician's childhood in a cult and in poverty; dark and painful but powerful.

before we were yours.title: Before We Were Yours
before we were yours.author: Lisa Wingate
before we were yours.why: Based on the real Tennessee Children's Home Society scandal; readers cried and were broken-hearted.

against a dark background.title: Against a Dark Background
against a dark background.author: Iain M. Banks

nineteen eighty four.title: Nineteen Eighty-Four
nineteen eighty four.author: George Orwell
nineteen eighty four.why: Orwell's chilling vision of a totalitarian state and surveillance; its opening draws readers in.

trainspotting.title: Trainspotting
trainspotting.author: Irvine Welsh

mysterious island.title: The Mysterious Island
mysterious island.author: Jules Verne

friday afternoon club.title: The Friday Afternoon Club

lullaby.title: Lullaby
lullaby.author: Chuck Palahniuk

red rabbit.title: Red Rabbit
red rabbit.author: Alex Grecian
red rabbit.why: An immersive Old West tale of pursuit; readers call it so good they cannot recommend it enough.

elsewhere.title: Elsewhere
elsewhere.author: Gabrielle Zevin
elsewhere.why: A teen girl wakes in the afterlife and learns to live backward in age; a gentle, lasting story about death.

blue sisters.title: Blue Sisters
blue sisters.author: Coco Mellors
blue sisters.why: Comments are mixed and focus on a bad audio narrator.

well of ascension.title: The Well of Ascension
well of ascension.author: Brandon Sanderson
well of ascension.why: Comments only mention reading it, no recommendation.

glass hotel.title: The Glass Hotel
glass hotel.author: Emily St. John Mandel

deadhouse gates.title: Deadhouse Gates (The Malazan Book of the Fallen, Book 2)

london.title: London
london.author: Edward Rutherfurd
london.why: Follows several families through two thousand years of London's history.

new jim crow.title: The New Jim Crow

katherine.title: Katherine
katherine.author: Anya Seton

carls doomsday scenario.title: Carl's Doomsday Scenario

mr mercedes.title: Mr. Mercedes

maidens.title: The Maidens

rascal.title: Rascal
rascal.author: Sterling North

dream hotel.title: The Dream Hotel
dream hotel.author: Laila Lalami

firekeepers daughter.title: Firekeeper's Daughter
firekeepers daughter.author: Angeline Boulley

drood.title: Drood
drood.author: Dan Simmons
drood.why: Wilkie Collins narrates Dickens's last years and a sinister mystery in Victorian London; a huge, immersive book that divides readers.

temeraire.title: His Majesty's Dragon (Temeraire)
temeraire.author: Naomi Novik

modelland.title: Modelland
modelland.author: Tyra Banks
modelland.why: Named only as a laughably bad book.

sound of a wild snail eating.title: The Sound of a Wild Snail Eating
sound of a wild snail eating.author: Elisabeth Tova Bailey
sound of a wild snail eating.why: A bedridden woman observes a wild snail and finds meaning in slowness; readers facing illness find it quietly comforting.

malice.title: Malice
malice.author: John Gwynne
malice.why: Mentioned only by readers who gave up on it.

as meat loves salt.title: As Meat Loves Salt
as meat loves salt.author: Maria McCann
as meat loves salt.why: A soldier's obsessive path through the English Civil War; praised as an unsettling, little-known gem.

fried green tomatoes at the whistle stop.title: Fried Green Tomatoes at the Whistle Stop Cafe
fried green tomatoes at the whistle stop.author: Fannie Flagg
fried green tomatoes at the whistle stop.why: Warm Southern storytelling across generations built around women's friendship; recommended when friendship matters more than romance.

crossing to safety.title: Crossing to Safety
crossing to safety.author: Wallace Stegner
crossing to safety.why: Two couples' friendship over decades told in quiet, beautiful prose; loved as a reflective, wholesome favourite.

strange pictures.title: Strange Pictures
strange pictures.author: Uketsu
strange pictures.why: A Japanese mystery solved through odd drawings and diagrams; a quick, addictive read that readers could not put down.

unselected journals of emma m lion.title: The Unselected Journals of Emma M. Lion
unselected journals of emma m lion.author: Beth Brower

lotr.title: Łotr
lotr.author: Trudi Canavan
lotr.why: Wrong match; the comments only mention The Lord of the Rings.

rules of civility.title: Rules of Civility
rules of civility.author: Amor Towles

still alice.title: Still Alice
still alice.author: Lisa Genova
still alice.why: A professor faces early-onset Alzheimer's; readers find it heartbreaking and eye-opening.

wizard knight.title: The Wizard Knight
wizard knight.author: Gene Wolfe

sophies choice.title: Sophie's Choice
sophies choice.author: William Styron

lanark.title: Lanark
lanark.author: Alasdair Gray

naked.title: Naked
naked.author: David Sedaris
naked.why: Funny autobiographical essays about family and odd jobs; readers say it made them laugh to tears.

veldt.title: The Veldt
veldt.author: Ray Bradbury
veldt.why: A short story about a high-tech nursery that turns sinister; readers say it stays with them long after.

geralds game.title: Gerald's Game
geralds game.author: Stephen King

ducks.title: Ducks: Two Years in the Oil Sands

ducks.why: A cartoonist's memoir of working in Alberta's oil fields; praised as a moving, honest account of isolation and harassment.

strange the dreamer.title: Strange the Dreamer
strange the dreamer.author: Laini Taylor

flight behavior.title: Flight Behavior

inherent vice.title: Inherent Vice

in watermelon sugar.title: In Watermelon Sugar

forever amber.title: Forever Amber

portnoys complaint.title: Portnoy's Complaint

iron druid chronicles.title: Hounded: The Iron Druid Chronicles

anubis gates.title: The Anubis Gates

milk fed.title: Milk Fed
milk fed.author: Melissa Broder
milk fed.why: A woman with an eating disorder becomes obsessed with a Jewish shop clerk; strange, funny and compelling.

fury.title: The Fury
fury.author: Alex Michaelides
fury.why: Named only as an example of poor writing.

serviceberry.title: The Serviceberry
serviceberry.author: Robin Wall Kimmerer
serviceberry.why: A short essay on gift economies and abundance seen through a berry bush; readers keep recommending it.

night land.title: The Night Land
night land.author: William Hope Hodgson
night land.why: Humanity's last pyramid refuge under a dead sun; a demanding, archaic-voiced classic that readers find rewarding.

tropic of cancer.title: Tropic of Cancer

painted house.title: A Painted House
painted house.author: John Grisham

im starting to worry about this black bo.title: I'm Starting to Worry About This Black Box of Doom

prey.title: Prey
prey.author: Michael Crichton
prey.why: Swarming nanorobots escape from a lab; a quick, gripping techno-thriller.

marrow thieves.title: The Marrow Thieves
marrow thieves.author: Cherie Dimaline

chronicles of st marys.title: Just One Damn Thing After Another
chronicles of st marys.author: Jodi Taylor
chronicles of st marys.why: Historians time-travel into disasters in a chaotic British institute; a witty, addictive series recommended for light reading.

at swim two birds.title: At Swim-Two-Birds
at swim two birds.author: Flann O'Brien
at swim two birds.why: A student writes a novel whose characters rebel against him; wildly funny Irish metafiction.

animal.title: Animal
animal.author: Lisa Taddeo
animal.why: A woman fleeing a violent past reckons with men and rage; liked for its voice and unhinged intensity.

disappearing spoon.title: The Disappearing Spoon

einsteins dreams.title: Einstein's Dreams
einsteins dreams.author: Alan Lightman
einsteins dreams.why: Short imagined dreams about different ways time might work; readers revisit favourite chapters.

razors edge.title: The Razor's Edge
razors edge.author: W. Somerset Maugham

wyrd sisters.title: Wyrd Sisters

maurice.title: Maurice
maurice.author: E. M. Forster

five people you meet in heaven.title: The Five People You Meet in Heaven

desert solitaire.title: Desert Solitaire

walking to aldebaran.title: Walking to Aldebaran
walking to aldebaran.author: Adrian Tchaikovsky

house on mango street.title: The House on Mango Street

allegedly.title: Allegedly
allegedly.author: Tiffany D. Jackson

reamde.title: Reamde

narcissus and goldmund.title: Narcissus and Goldmund
narcissus and goldmund.author: Hermann Hesse
narcissus and goldmund.why: Two medieval friends, a monk and a wanderer, pursue opposite paths of spirit and sensuality; a beautifully written classic.

margos got money troubles.title: Margo's Got Money Troubles

last man.title: The Last Man

bridge of birds.title: Bridge of Birds
bridge of birds.author: Barry Hughart
bridge of birds.why: A sage and his strong-armed sidekick solve a mystery in mythical ancient China; hilarious, moving and often reread.

tuck everlasting.title: Tuck Everlasting

way station.title: Way Station

luminous dead.title: The Luminous Dead
luminous dead.author: Caitlin Starling
luminous dead.why: A woman caving on an alien planet depends on a handler with secret motives; a claustrophobic sci-fi horror.

fire next time.title: The Fire Next Time

fire next time.why: Two powerful essays on race, religion and America; widely recommended as essential reading.

love songs of w e b du bois.title: The Love Songs of W.E.B. Du Bois
love songs of w e b du bois.author: Honorée Fanonne Jeffers
love songs of w e b du bois.why: A Black woman traces her family's history across generations of the American South; praised for beautiful writing.

little liar.title: The Little Liar

little liar.why: A boy in Nazi-occupied Greece unwittingly helps betray his neighbours; a tearjerker readers recommend.

blue highways.title: Blue Highways

blue highways.why: A drive around small-town America on back roads; a travel classic with descriptive prose.

translation state.title: Translation State

translation state.why: Translators and identity in the Imperial Radch universe; readers enjoyed it, though earlier books help.

moveable feast.title: A Moveable Feast
moveable feast.author: Ernest Hemingway
moveable feast.why: Hemingway's memories of young writing life in 1920s Paris; admired for its simple, beautiful language.

dark age.title: Dark Age
dark age.author: Pierce Brown
dark age.why: Fourth Red Rising book of relentless space war and politics; readers find it impossible to put down.

charlottes web.title: Charlotte's Web
charlottes web.author: E. B. White
charlottes web.why: A pig is saved by a spider's words; a children's classic readers remember for its famous opening line and gentle wisdom.

trout fishing in america.title: Trout Fishing in America

crow road.title: The Crow Road

pines.title: Pines
pines.author: Blake Crouch

candy house.title: The Candy House

candy house.why: Interlinked stories about a device that uploads memory; inventive and sharp, praised as stunningly good.

homecoming.title: Homecoming
homecoming.author: Kate Morton
homecoming.why: Comments mention several unrelated Homecoming books; no clear recommendation.

talented mr ripley.title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
talented mr ripley.author: Patricia Highsmith
talented mr ripley.why: A charming con man slides into murder and identity theft in Italy; a suspense classic recommended for its chilling protagonist.

thud.title: Thud!

thud.why: Commander Vimes confronts a dwarf-troll tension in Ankh-Morpork; a fan-favourite Discworld Watch story.

horns.title: Horns
horns.author: Joe Hill
horns.why: A man wakes with horns and the power to hear people's sins while hunting his girlfriend's killer; readers say it beats the film.

border trilogy.title: The Border Trilogy (All the Pretty Horses / The Crossing / Cities of the Plain)
border trilogy.author: Cormac McCarthy
border trilogy.why: Cormac McCarthy's three linked novels of cowboys in the borderlands; a recommended masterpiece for fans of Western epics.

angels.title: Angels
angels.author: Denis Johnson
angels.why: Denis Johnson's raw debut about drifters on a doomed road trip; readers say it stuck with them.

final empire.title: The Final Empire
final empire.author: Brandon Sanderson
final empire.why: A thief crew plots to topple an immortal ruler in a world of ash; a gripping, hard-to-put-down start to Mistborn.

time enough for love.title: Time Enough For Love
time enough for love.author: Robert A. Heinlein
time enough for love.why: The oldest man alive reflects on his many lives; readers say it changed their sense of what matters.

oliver twist.title: Oliver Twist

oliver twist.why: An orphan falls among London thieves; Dickens's classic about poverty and kindness, liked by readers who enjoy his style.

priestdaddy.title: Priestdaddy
priestdaddy.author: Patricia Lockwood
priestdaddy.why: A poet's memoir about living with her eccentric Catholic priest father; praised as hilarious and beautifully written.

plague dogs.title: The Plague Dogs

plague dogs.why: Two dogs escape a laboratory and struggle to survive; an uncomfortable but gripping story that readers say is well worth it.

penance.title: Penance

ship who sang.title: The Ship Who Sang

steerswoman.title: The Steerswoman
steerswoman.author: Rosemary Kirstein

summer.title: Summer
summer.author: Edith Wharton
summer.why: A young woman in a New England village falls into a doomed romance; praised as piercing and beautiful.

nights dawn trilogy.title: The Night's Dawn Trilogy

firefly.title: Firefly
firefly.author: Piers Anthony
firefly.why: Named only to warn readers away because of disturbing content.

king rat.title: King Rat
king rat.author: James Clavell
king rat.why: Prisoners of war struggle to survive in a Japanese camp; recommended as gripping.

friday.title: Friday
friday.author: Robert A. Heinlein
friday.why: Comments refer to other books titled Friday; no clear recommendation.

shards of earth.title: Shards of Earth
shards of earth.author: Adrian Tchaikovsky
shards of earth.why: Humans and alien species fight cosmic threats in a Mass Effect-style space opera; good from start to finish.

final girl support group.title: The Final Girl Support Group
final girl support group.author: Grady Hendrix
final girl support group.why: Slasher survivors in therapy are hunted again; a clever, fast horror-comedy readers enjoy.

sandman.title: Sandman
sandman.author: Neil Gaiman
sandman.why: Neil Gaiman's dark fantasy comic about the lord of dreams; readers call it a masterpiece.

slow horses.title: Slow Horses
slow horses.author: Mick Herron

secret life of bees.title: The secret life of bees
